# Aphrody

> The files of the video game *Inazuma Eleven: Victory Road*, served from their original
> in-game paths. Textures, models, sounds and videos are decoded on demand; the catalogues are
> also available as paginated JSON. Nothing here is transcoded ahead of time and nothing is
> renamed: a path on this site is the path inside the game.

Aphrody is served by a single Rust process. Three languages share one origin, distinguished by
a URL segment: French at the root, English under `/en/`, Japanese under `/ja/`. The three are
declared to each other with `hreflang`; the content behind them is the same catalogue.

If you are an agent, prefer the JSON API below over the HTML pages. It is paginated, stable,
and returns the same identifiers the game uses.

## Catalogues (HTML)

- [Textures]({{ origine }}/textures): every texture, at its original path, converted on demand.
- [Models]({{ origine }}/modeles): assembled and exportable models.
- [Sounds]({{ origine }}/sons): audio banks (ACB, AWB, HCA), decoded on demand.
- [Videos]({{ origine }}/videos): in-game videos (USM).

## JSON API

- [Service health]({{ origine }}/api/v1/health): what this instance can currently answer.
- [Characters]({{ origine }}/api/v1/chara): names in French, English and Japanese.
- [A catalogue]({{ origine }}/api/v1/textures): also `modeles`, `sons`, `videos`.
- [Episodes]({{ origine }}/api/v1/episodes): the animated series catalogue.

Pagination is `?page=` and `?per_page=` on every list; `per_page` defaults to 50 and is capped
at 200. Responses carry a total, so a crawl is bounded before it starts.

## Files

- `{{ origine }}/f/<vfs path>` — one file, at its exact in-game path, extension preserved.
- `{{ origine }}/b/<vfs prefix>` — list one directory of the game's virtual filesystem.

There are around 255 000 files. They are deliberately excluded from `robots.txt` and from the
sitemap: crawling them one by one is the wrong shape for this data. Use `/b/` to walk the tree,
or the catalogue API to select first.

## Optional

- [Full reference]({{ origine }}/llms-full.txt): URL conventions, formats, limits, examples.
- [Sitemap]({{ origine }}/sitemap.xml): every page, in all three languages.
